correctness.rationale: All-circumference proof derives three exact boundary equations from the Rule 45 truth table and fixed update order; the interior equality marks are precisely 01 input edges. An explicit construction proves the converse for all legal marks, and the injective y-to-(start,marks,final XOR) map yields F_n+2F_(n-1)=L_n. Both boundary conventions and n=3 are included. Direct exhaustive C++ checks through n=20, independent Python checks through n=15, and an independent existential inverse test through n=11 agree. No infinite claim depends on finite experiments.

value.rationale: Exact one-sweep image reachability and entropy are intrinsic invariants of a specified sequential cellular automaton, relevant to the loss of state information under an update schedule singled out by a published convergence conjecture. The proof classifies all reachable words, not an arbitrary finite sample, and demonstrates an exact golden-ratio information bottleneck independent of the period-three existence of fixed points. The result has useful stand-alone mathematical value without claiming to resolve the convergence conjecture.
